card.name: Nouns like subject, storm, war after "the"
card.fires_on: Topic nouns such as subject, storm, war or conflict right after "the" or "a great", in general news and history prose. It also fires on the start of "stormy".

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward compound words ending in maker or matter, such as subject matter or war maker.
card.plain: It lights up on big topic nouns like war, storm or subject when they follow "the" in news and history writing.
